items.title: Phase offset doesn't scale with `hscale`
items.summary: The reporter describes changing hscale moving the relative clock-edge alignment while leaving phase unchanged. The supplied negative-phase clock example was read, not replayed here.

items.author: reedbn
items.summary: The commenter references issue 53 and discusses compatibility and a possible explicit convention for phase.

items.author: drom
items.quote: The number of phase shift rotation steps depends on hscale parameter
items.summary: The maintainer's examples give different angle interpretations for the same phase values at hscale 2 and 3. This is documented historical behavior, not a newly discovered defect.
